sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the
إجراءات الصيانة الرئيسية 
P1, which must be carried out
every four years as 
indicated by Y4 in the above title block. This pump is used to pumped 
feed water from feed water tank to high pressure heater.

The first draft initiated 
and tested by eng. 
Adel Saad Zaghloul, reviewed by eng. 
Sobhy Abel Halim, 
accepted by eng. 
محمد عبد ال 
غفار 
general director of 
Alarish PS, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Abouda Elbana.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Disconnect the suction & discharge flanges and 
 all oil and water piping including the balancing line

Be sure pump 
 must be completely drainage.
Remove all instruments.

Remove the pump protection guard and 
 insulating cover.

sections.text: التفكيك

Journal Support Front 
Side ( 351.01 352.02)

Remove the centering pins (566.05), remove the screws (901.03) dismantle the 
 half upper case (352.02).

Lift the shaft slightly, rotate the half lower bearing (313.02) and the 
 labyrinth seal ring (423.02) inside housing to remove them.

Remove the upper part of bearing and labyrinth by disjunction as it is 
 provided for stop pins that prevent their rotation.
Dismantle the mechanical seal (433.01) but install again flange.

ضع الكم (18) والحلقة في نصفين (19) بدلاً من المجلة 
 تحمل (313.02).
Install the upper support casing (352.02) and lock on the lower one (351.02).
Lock the shaft by action on the screw 20.

sections.text:
Thrust Support Rear Side 
( 351.01 352.02)

Dismantle the lubrication screw pump (632.01) unscrew the screw (901.01), 
 remove the support cover (169.01) and O ring (412.09).
Disconnect the upper half of the support case (352.01).

Dismantle the journal bearing (313.01) both thrust half bearings and labyrinth 
 split ring (423.01) as mentioned before (on the front side).
Straighten the lock washer (931.01), unscrew the bearing nut (923.01).
With draw the locating sleeve (527.01).
قم بإزالة المفتاح (940.04) واسحب حلقة تحديد الموقع (519.01).
Sling the bearing housing by slightly pulling the lifting ropes.
Remove the bearing housing.

sections.text:
Impellers Inter Stage 
Casing, Diffuser

Install the plate (1) complete with guide (2) on the base plate, install the 
 support (6) with screw (7) on the tooth of the inter stage casing to be 
 removed (the last one).

Lock the screw (9), adjust the height of inter mediate casing by acting on 
 screw (7).

Unloose the screw (13), remove the plate (10) and place it on the last inter 
 mediate casing, detach it and let it slide on the support guide and remove O- 
 ring (412.05).
Remove the diffuser from inter stage casing.
With draw impeller (last stage).
Remove the key (940.02).
With draw the spacer bush (543.01)
Repeat the method mentioned above to remove all stages.

sections.text: إعادة التجميع
Suction Casing

House the O- ring gasket (412.01), assemble the suction casing and 
 cooling jacket cover (165.02).
Pump Shaft
Spread o thin layer of anti seizing paste on the shaft.

Sling the shaft, lift it in the suction casing and place wooden blocks to 
 avoid bending and deformation.
Mount the mechanical seal flange

Mount the bearing housing lower half without bearing nor labyrinth , screw the 
 nuts (920.02), install the centering pins (566.03) and lock the screw 
 (920.02).

Install the special tools (18.19), install the half coupling and lock the 
 shaft.
Install the equipment for installation of the inter mediate casing.

sections.text:
Impeller, Inter Stage 
Casing, Diffusers

Mount the key (940.02), fit the first stage impeller adjust the clearance 
 between impeller and the seal ring (0.20 - 0.25 mm).

Mount the diffuser (171.01) on the inter stage casing (113.01) fit the 
 rotation preventing pin (562.01) and O ring (412.03).

With the aid of special tools. Sling the inter mediate casing and insert it on 
 the shaft.

Arrange four bolts with washer (11-14) and nuts (13) insert the plate (10) and 
 lock the nut (13), remove the sliding equipment on the inter stage casing.
Repeat above steps for assembly all stage.

sections.text: Tie Bolts
Use four tie bolts with centering bush (546.01) and nut (920.03).

Fit the tie bolts in the suction casing until the longest threaded part goes 
 out from the delivery side.
Mount the centering pin bush and nuts (920.03)
Tighten the tie rod one nut, then on the opposite one.

Unloose the four tie bolts, reset the pump perfectly on the base plate, lock 
 the suction casing on the base plate.
Place the delivery casing on the base plate without locking.
Tighten threads (with torque set 250 kgm.).

Oil level.
Cooling circuit open.
Open suction and delivery valve.
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
